File the thread of a message against an item; moving the message keeps the link

## Usage

```text
chainmail item link <id> <ref> [flags]
```

## Examples

```sh
chainmail item link it_01jcb7m2k9r8q3v4w5x6y7z8a9 cm1:work:INBOX:7:42 --anchor --note "the renewal notice"
# then find the item's mail
chainmail search item:it_01jcb7m2k9r8q3v4w5x6y7z8a9
```

## Flags

```text
      --anchor        make this message the link's anchor, the one the item is about
      --note string   why the thread belongs to the item (default: keep the note it has)
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```
